notes.title: Official Devlog Series: Unreal Engine C++ Development
notes.content:
[p]We’ve launched a YouTube devblog where we share regular updates on our game’s development process in Unreal Engine C++.  
[/p][p]The channel’s purpose is to give our community a closer look at how the project is evolving and to create a space where you can follow progress and share feedback or requests.  [/p][p][/p][p]👉 Check out the channel here: [url="https://www.youtube.com/@lobeliadev"]Youtube Dev Vlog[/url]


[/p]
